hotspots.title: Polish Constitutional Court Crisis & Coup Accusations
hotspots.blurb: Polish President Karol Nawrocki interrupted an official trip to Africa and entered the Constitutional Tribunal late at night following the suspension of top judge Bogdan Święczkowski by Anna Korwin-Piotrowska. PiS leader Jarosław Kaczyński and conservative commentators fiercely denounced the developments as an illegal 'coup d'état' and a forced takeover of the judiciary by Donald Tusk's government. The constitutional showdown has triggered widespread protests, physical confrontations at court facilities, and emergency cross-party consultations.
hotspots.affect: This crisis commands white-hot affective charge through existential claims of a state coup, dramatic late-night presidential intervention, and intense polarized rhetoric between government and opposition factions.

hotspots.title: Flávio Bolsonaro Defeat & Brazil Election Fraud Claims
hotspots.blurb: Following Flávio Bolsonaro's presidential defeat to Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, coverage has intensified around his departure from Brazil to Miami, allegedly assisted by a former Mossad operative in violation of judicial restrictions. US Secretary of State Marco Rubio denied direct US assistance while Donald Trump publicly stated Bolsonaro is welcome to stay in the United States indefinitely. In Brazil, left-wing groups demand the suspension of Bolsonaro's Senate salary while defense attorneys prepare supreme court appeals.
hotspots.affect: Disproportionate attention is driven by high-stakes international political drama, allegations of covert escape operations, and direct diplomatic friction between Washington, Brasilia, and Buenos Aires.

hotspots.title: Marine Le Pen Launches RN Campaign & Congress
hotspots.blurb: Marine Le Pen formally launched her 2027 presidential campaign in Orléans, outlining core platform promises while navigating legal uncertainty regarding her potential ineligibility ahead of a pending Cour de cassation ruling. Concurrently, French political coverage seized upon violent Halloween protests and attacks on police officers, which Le Pen and conservative figures cited as proof of societal decay under Macron. Party dynamics also featured tensions surrounding Marion Maréchal's presence and Jordan Bardella's high-profile media appearances.
hotspots.affect: The coverage achieves strong affective charge by linking Le Pen's presidential ambitions directly to broader moral panics around urban lawlessness, state authority, and institutional legitimacy.

hotspots.title: SD Internal Feud Over Swedish Identity Principles
hotspots.blurb: Sverigedemokraterna faces internal strife following committee chairman Richard Jomshof's assertion that Swedish identity requires specific cultural and biological heritage. Jomshof's statements sparked criticism from party leader Jimmie Åkesson and prompted threats of resignation from key figures, raising fears of ideological defections to Alternativ för Sverige. The rift coincides with contentious debates and conflicting reports over whether SD will drop demands for ministerial portfolios to secure a government agreement.
hotspots.affect: This issue captures high emotional investment because it strikes at the core ideological identity and internal stability of Sweden's primary right-wing party.

hotspots.title: Nigel Farage MP Altercation Row & Reform Campaign
hotspots.blurb: Nigel Farage and Reform UK remain focal points in British political media following a tense Parliamentary altercation and aggressive campaigning on military and spending policy. Farage has vocally opposed government discussions on historical slavery apologies while defending his party against attacks over campaign staff conduct and racial slurs directed at Conservative leader Kemi Badenoch by external allies. Reform UK continues to use these clashes to position itself as an unyielding populist alternative.
hotspots.affect: Reform UK maintains elevated narrative heat through aggressive anti-establishment posturing, culture-war provocations, and contentious media exchanges.
